snapshot.text: Compulsory health insurance on the Swiss model, with close ties to Swiss hospitals. Liechtenstein voted on a new national hospital, and ECDC published a public health emergency preparedness assessment (PHEPA) for the country in 2026.

priorities.title: ECDC preparedness assessment
priorities.text: ECDC's 2026 PHEPA for Liechtenstein reviews emergency preparedness.

priorities.title: Health insurance premiums
priorities.text: Premiums will rise more moderately in 2027.
